```vue
                  <p>{{ formatDate(voucher.startDate) }}</p>
                  <p>{{ formatDate(voucher.endDate) }}</p>
                </td>
                <td class="px-2 py-2">
                  <span
                    class="rounded-full px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold"
                    :class="statusClass(voucher.status)"
                  >
                    {{ voucher.statusLabel || voucherStatusLabel(voucher.status) }}
                  </span>
                </td>
                <td class="px-2 py-2">
                  {{ voucher.usedCount || 0 }}
                  <span v-if="voucher.usageLimit"
                    >/ {{ voucher.usageLimit }}</span
                  >
                </td>
                <td class="px-2 py-2 text-right">
                  <div class="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                    <button
                      class="rounded-lg p-1.5 hover:bg-slate-100 dark:hover:bg-white"
                      title="Chỉnh sửa"
                      @click="openEdit(voucher)"
                    >
                      <span
                        class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-slate-500"
                        >edit</span
                      >
                    </button>
                    <button
                      class="rounded-lg p-1.5 hover:bg-red-50 dark:hover:bg-red-900/20"
                      title="Xóa"
                      @click="confirmDelete(voucher)"
                    >
                      <span
                        class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-red-500"
                        >delete</span
                      >
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>

    <Teleport to="body">
      <div
        v-if="showModal"
        class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4"
        @click.self="closeModal"
      >
        <div
          class="w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto rounded-2xl bg-white p-4 shadow-2xl "
        >
          <h3 class="mb-4 text-base font-bold">
            {{
              editingVoucherId
                ? `Sửa voucher #${editingVoucherId}`
                : "Thêm voucher mới"
            }}
          </h3>

          <div class="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
            <div>
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Mã voucher *</label
              >
              <input
                v-model.trim="form.code"
                type="text"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm uppercase "
                placeholder="VD: PEAK10"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Loại giảm *</label
              >
              <select
                v-model="form.discountType"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm "
              >
                <option value="PERCENT">PERCENT</option>
                <option value="AMOUNT">AMOUNT</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Giá trị giảm *</label
              >
              <input
                v-model.number="form.discountValue"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm "
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Đơn tối thiểu</label
              >
              <input
                v-model.number="form.minOrderValue"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm "
              />
            </div>

            <div v-if="form.discountType === 'PERCENT'">
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Giảm tối đa (đ)</label
              >
              <input
                v-model.number="form.maxDiscountAmount"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                placeholder="VD: 50000"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm "
              />
              <p class="mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-400">Để trống = không giới hạn</p>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Bắt đầu</label
              >
              <input
                v-model="form.startDate"
                type="datetime-local"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm "
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Kết thúc</label
              >
              <input
                v-model="form.endDate"
                type="datetime-local"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm "
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label class="mb-1 block text-xs font-medium text-slate-500"
                >Giới hạn sử dụng</label
              >
              <input
                v-model.number="form.usageLimit"
                type="number"
                min="0"
                class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm "
              />
            </div>

            <label class="inline-flex items-center gap-2 text-sm md:pt-6">
              <input v-model="form.isActive" type="checkbox" />
              <span>Voucher đang hoạt động</span>
            </label>
          </div>

          <p v-if="modalError" class="mt-3 text-xs text-red-500">
            {{ modalError }}
          </p>

          <div class="mt-4 flex justify-end gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              class="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium hover:border-slate-400 "
              @click="closeModal"
            >
              Hủy
            </button>

            <button
              type="button"
              :disabled="saving"
              class="rounded-xl bg-primary px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-60"
              @click="saveVoucher"
            >
              {{
                saving
                  ? "Đang lưu..."
                  : editingVoucherId
                    ? "Cập nhật"
                    : "Thêm mới"
              }}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Teleport>

    <Teleport to="body">
      <div
        v-if="deleteTarget"
        class="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4"
        @click.self="deleteTarget = null"
      >
        <div
          class="w-full max-w-sm rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl "
        >
          <h3 class="mb-2 text-base font-bold">Xác nhận xóa</h3>
          <p class="text-sm text-slate-500 ">
            Bạn chắc chắn muốn xóa voucher
            <strong>{{ deleteTarget.code }}</strong
            >?
          </p>

          <div class="mt-5 flex justify-end gap-3">
            <button
              class="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium "
              @click="deleteTarget = null"
            >
              Hủy
            </button>
            <button
              :disabled="deleting"
              class="rounded-xl bg-red-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-red-600 disabled:opacity-60"
              @click="doDelete"
            >
              {{ deleting ? "Đang xóa..." : "Xóa" }}
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </Teleport>
  </AdminShell>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from "vue";

import AdminShell from "@/components/admin/AdminShell.vue";
import { adminApi } from "@/services/api";

const loading = ref(false);
const error = ref("");
const vouchers = ref([]);
const search = ref("");
const statusFilter = ref("ALL");
const hiddenVouchers = ref([]);

const showModal = ref(false);
const editingVoucherId = ref(null);
const saving = ref(false);
const modalError = ref("");
const form = ref(emptyForm());

const deleteTarget = ref(null);
const deleting = ref(false);

const visibleVouchers = computed(() => {
  return vouchers.value.filter(
    (voucher) =>
      !hiddenVouchers.value.some(
        (hidden) => Number(voucher.id) === Number(hidden.id),
      ),
  );
});

const filteredVouchers = computed(() => {
  const keyword = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  return visibleVouchers.value.filter((voucher) => {
    const statusMatch =
      statusFilter.value === "ALL" || voucher.status === statusFilter.value;
    if (!statusMatch) {
      return false;
    }

    if (!keyword) {
      return true;
    }

    const haystack = [voucher.code, voucher.discountType, voucher.status]
      .filter(Boolean)
      .join(" ")
      .toLowerCase();
    return haystack.includes(keyword);
  });
});

const activeCount = computed(() => {
  return vouchers.value.filter((voucher) => voucher.status === "ACTIVE").length;
});

const inactiveCount = computed(() => {
  return vouchers.value.filter((voucher) =>
    ["USED", "EXPIRED", "INACTIVE"].includes(voucher.status),
  ).length;
});

function normalizeVoucherStatusValue(status) {
  const normalized = String(status || "INACTIVE")
    .trim()
    .toUpperCase();
  if (
    ["ACTIVE", "INACTIVE", "SCHEDULED", "USED", "EXPIRED"].includes(normalized)
  ) {
    return normalized;
  }
  return "INACTIVE";
}

function voucherStatusLabel(status) {
  const normalized = normalizeVoucherStatusValue(status);
  if (normalized === "ACTIVE") return "Đang hoạt động";
  if (normalized === "SCHEDULED") return "Sắp diễn ra";
  if (normalized === "USED") return "Đã hết lượt";
  if (normalized === "EXPIRED") return "Hết hạn";
  return "Không hoạt động";
}

function emptyForm() {
  return {
    code: "",
    discountType: "PERCENT",
    discountValue: 0,
    minOrderValue: 0,
    maxDiscountAmount: null,
    startDate: "",
    endDate: "",
    usageLimit: null,
    isActive: true,
  };
}

function formatMoney(value) {
  const amount = Number(value);
  return new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN", {
    style: "currency",
    currency: "VND",
    maximumFractionDigits: 0,
  }).format(Number.isFinite(amount) ? amount : 0);
}

function formatDiscount(voucher) {
  if (voucher.discountType === "PERCENT") {
    const pct = `${Number(voucher.discountValue || 0)}%`;
    if (voucher.maxDiscountAmount) {
      return `${pct} (tối đa ${formatMoney(voucher.maxDiscountAmount)})`;
    }
    return pct;
  }
  return formatMoney(voucher.discountValue || 0);
}

function formatDate(value) {
  const date = new Date(value || 0);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return "-";
  }
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("vi-VN", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",
  }).format(date);
}

function toDatetimeLocal(value) {
  const date = new Date(value || "");
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    return "";
  }

  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  const hour = String(date.getHours()).padStart(2, "0");
  const minute = String(date.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}T${hour}:${minute}`;
}

function statusClass(status) {
  const normalized = normalizeVoucherStatusValue(status);
  if (normalized === "ACTIVE") {
    return "bg-green-100 text-green-700 /20 ";
  }
  if (normalized === "USED") {
    return "bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 /50 ";
  }
  if (normalized === "SCHEDULED") {
    return "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700 /20 ";
  }
  if (normalized === "INACTIVE") {
    return "bg-amber-100 text-amber-700 /20 ";
  }
  return "bg-red-100 text-red-700 /20 ";
}

function openCreate() {
  editingVoucherId.value = null;
  form.value = emptyForm();
  modalError.value = "";
  showModal.value = true;
}

function openEdit(voucher) {
  editingVoucherId.value = voucher.id;
  form.value = {
    code: voucher.code || "",
    discountType: voucher.discountType || "PERCENT",
    discountValue: Number(voucher.discountValue || 0),
    minOrderValue: Number(voucher.minOrderValue || 0),
    maxDiscountAmount:
      voucher.maxDiscountAmount !== null && voucher.maxDiscountAmount !== undefined
        ? Number(voucher.maxDiscountAmount)
        : null,
    startDate: toDatetimeLocal(voucher.startDate),
    endDate: toDatetimeLocal(voucher.endDate),
    usageLimit:
      voucher.usageLimit !== null && voucher.usageLimit !== undefined
        ? Number(voucher.usageLimit)
        : null,
    isActive: !!voucher.isActive,
  };
  modalError.value = "";
  showModal.value = true;
}

function closeModal() {
  showModal.value = false;
}

async function saveVoucher() {
  const f = form.value;
  modalError.value = "";

  if (!f.code) {
    modalError.value = "Vui lòng nhập mã voucher.";
    return;
  }

  if (Number(f.discountValue) <= 0) {
    modalError.value = "Giá trị giảm phải lớn hơn 0.";
    return;
  }

  saving.value = true;
  try {
    const payload = {
      code: String(f.code).trim().toUpperCase(),
      discountType: String(f.discountType || "PERCENT").toUpperCase(),
      discountValue: Number(f.discountValue || 0),
      minOrderValue: Number(f.minOrderValue || 0),
      maxDiscountAmount:
        f.discountType === "PERCENT" &&
        f.maxDiscountAmount !== "" &&
        f.maxDiscountAmount !== null &&
        f.maxDiscountAmount !== undefined
          ? Number(f.maxDiscountAmount)
          : null,
      startDate: f.startDate || null,
      endDate: f.endDate || null,
      usageLimit:
        f.usageLimit === "" ||
        f.usageLimit === null ||
        f.usageLimit === undefined
          ? null
          : Number(f.usageLimit),
      isActive: !!f.isActive,
    };

    if (editingVoucherId.value) {
      await adminApi.updateVoucher(editingVoucherId.value, payload);
    } else {
      await adminApi.createVoucher(payload);
    }

    closeModal();
    await loadVouchers();
  } catch (err) {
    modalError.value = err?.message || "Không thể lưu voucher.";
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}

function confirmDelete(voucher) {
  deleteTarget.value = voucher;
}

async function doDelete() {
  if (!deleteTarget.value) {
    return;
  }

  deleting.value = true;
  try {
    const result = await adminApi.deleteVoucher(deleteTarget.value.id);

    if (result && result.softDeleted) {
      if (
        !hiddenVouchers.value.some(
          (voucher) => Number(voucher.id) === Number(deleteTarget.value.id),
        )
      ) {
        hiddenVouchers.value.push(deleteTarget.value);
      }
      deleteTarget.value = null;
      return;
    }

    deleteTarget.value = null;
    await loadVouchers();
  } catch (err) {
    error.value = err?.message || "Không thể xóa voucher.";
  } finally {
    deleting.value = false;
  }
}

async function restoreVoucher(voucher) {
  try {
    await adminApi.restoreVoucher(voucher.id);
    const restoredId = Number(voucher?.id);
    hiddenVouchers.value = hiddenVouchers.value.filter(
      (hidden) => Number(hidden.id) !== restoredId,
    );
    await loadVouchers();
  } catch (err) {
    error.value = "Không thể khôi phục voucher.";
  }
}

async function restoreAllHiddenVouchers() {
  try {
    for (const voucher of hiddenVouchers.value) {
      await adminApi.restoreVoucher(voucher.id);
    }
    hiddenVouchers.value = [];
    await loadVouchers();
  } catch (err) {
    error.value = "Có lỗi xảy ra khi khôi phục.";
  }
}

async function loadVouchers() {
  loading.value = true;
  error.value = "";

  try {
    const data = await adminApi.getVouchers({ page: 0, size: 400 });
    vouchers.value = Array.isArray(data) ? data : [];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to load vouchers:", err);
    error.value =
      "Không thể tải danh sách voucher. Vui lòng kiểm tra backend API.";
  } finally {
    loading.value = false;
  }
}

onMounted(loadVouchers);
</script>

```

```vue
<template>
  <AdminShell>
    <template #header>
      <div class="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">

          <p class="text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.18em] text-primary">Hồ sơ admin</p>

    <section class="retail-card p-6">
      <div v-if="message" class="mb-4 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm" :class="messageType === 'error' ? 'border border-red-200 bg-red-50 text-red-700 /40 /20 ' : 'border border-green-200 bg-green-50 text-green-700 /40 /20 '">

      <form class="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2" @submit.prevent="saveSettings">

        <label class="md:col-span-2 flex flex-col gap-2">

        <div class="md:col-span-2 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 p-4 ">
          <p class="text-sm font-medium">Đổi mật khẩu</p>
          <p class="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 ">Để trống nếu bạn không muốn thay đổi mật khẩu.</p>

          <div class="mt-3 grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">

            <label class="flex flex-col gap-2">

              <input
                v-model="form.confirmPassword"

                class=" shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm outline-none focus:border-primary "
              />

          </div>

        <div class="md:col-span-2 flex justify-end">
          <button
            type="submit"

            <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">save</span>

<script setup>
import { computed, onMounted, ref } from "vue";

import AdminShell from "@/components/admin/AdminShell.vue";
import { accountsApi, resolveBackendAssetUrl } from "@/services/api";

const API_BASE_URL = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || "http://localhost:8080/api";

const saving = ref(false);
const message = ref("");
const messageType = ref("success");
const accountId = ref(null);

const fileInput = ref(null);
const avatarFile = ref(null);
const avatarPreview = ref("");
const uploadError = ref("");

const form = ref({
  username: "",
  gmail: "",
  phone: "",
  address: "",
  imgUrl: null,
  newPassword: "",
  confirmPassword: "",
});

const resolvedAvatar = computed(() => {
  return normalizeAvatarUrl(avatarPreview.value || form.value.imgUrl || "");
});

function normalizeAvatarUrl(rawUrl) {
  if (!rawUrl || typeof rawUrl !== "string") {
    return "";
  }

  const fixedUrl = rawUrl.replace(
    /^https?:\/\/[^/]+\/?(https?:\/\/.+)$/i,
    "$1",
  );

  return resolveBackendAssetUrl(fixedUrl) || "";
}

function getLoggedInUser() {
  try {
    return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("user") || "{}");
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function triggerAvatarUpload() {
  fileInput.value?.click();
}

function handleAvatarChange(event) {
  const file = event.target.files && event.target.files[0] ? event.target.files[0] : null;
  if (!file) {
    return;
  }

  if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
    uploadError.value = "Vui lòng chọn tệp ảnh hợp lệ.";
    return;
  }

  if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
    uploadError.value = "Ảnh phải nhỏ hơn 2MB.";
    return;
  }

  uploadError.value = "";
  avatarFile.value = file;

  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (e) => {
    avatarPreview.value = e.target && e.target.result ? String(e.target.result) : "";
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

function removeAvatar() {
  avatarFile.value = null;
  avatarPreview.value = "";
  form.value.imgUrl = null;
  uploadError.value = "";

  if (fileInput.value) {
    fileInput.value.value = "";
  }
}

async function uploadAvatar(currentAccountId) {
  if (!avatarFile.value) {
    return form.value.imgUrl || null;
  }

  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append("file", avatarFile.value);

  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/accounts/${currentAccountId}/upload-avatar`, {
    method: "POST",
    body: formData,
  });

  let data = null;
  try {
    data = await response.json();
  } catch {
    data = null;
  }

  if (!response.ok) {
    const messageText =
      data && typeof data === "object" && (data.message || data.error)
        ? data.message || data.error
        : `Upload avatar thất bại (HTTP ${response.status})`;
    throw new Error(messageText);
  }

  const nextImageUrl =
    data && typeof data === "object"
      ? data.imageUrl || data.imgUrl || data.url || null
      : null;

  if (!nextImageUrl) {
    throw new Error("Máy chủ không trả về đường dẫn ảnh.");
  }

  return nextImageUrl;
}

async function loadSettings() {
  const user = getLoggedInUser();
  const id = Number(user.id);
  if (!Number.isFinite(id) || id <= 0) {
    message.value = "Không tìm thấy tài khoản đăng nhập.";
    messageType.value = "error";
    return;
  }

  accountId.value = id;

  try {
    const account = await accountsApi.getById(id);
    form.value = {
      username: account.username || "",
      gmail: account.gmail || "",
      phone: account.phone || "",
      address: account.address || "",
      imgUrl: account.imgUrl || null,
      newPassword: "",
      confirmPassword: "",
    };
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to load admin settings:", err);
    message.value = "Không thể tải thông tin tài khoản.";
    messageType.value = "error";
  }
}

async function saveSettings() {
  if (!accountId.value) {
    message.value = "Không tìm thấy tài khoản hợp lệ để cập nhật.";
    messageType.value = "error";
    return;
  }

  saving.value = true;
  message.value = "";

  try {
    const uploadedAvatarUrl = await uploadAvatar(accountId.value);
    const newPassword = String(form.value.newPassword || "");
    const confirmPassword = String(form.value.confirmPassword || "");

    if (newPassword || confirmPassword) {
      if (newPassword.length < 6) {
        throw new Error("Mật khẩu mới cần tối thiểu 6 ký tự.");
      }

      if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
        throw new Error("Xác nhận mật khẩu không khớp.");
      }
    }

    const payload = {
      username: form.value.username,
      gmail: form.value.gmail,
      phone: form.value.phone,
      address: form.value.address,
      imgUrl: uploadedAvatarUrl || null,
    };

    if (newPassword) {
      payload.password = newPassword;
    }

    const updated = await accountsApi.update(accountId.value, payload);

    const localUser = getLoggedInUser();
    const merged = {
      ...localUser,
      ...updated,
      imgUrl: updated.imgUrl || payload.imgUrl || null,
    };
    localStorage.setItem("user", JSON.stringify(merged));

    form.value.imgUrl = merged.imgUrl || null;
    form.value.newPassword = "";
    form.value.confirmPassword = "";
    avatarFile.value = null;
    avatarPreview.value = "";
    uploadError.value = "";

    if (fileInput.value) {
      fileInput.value.value = "";
    }

    message.value = "Cập nhật tài khoản thành công.";
    messageType.value = "success";
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to update admin settings:", err);
    message.value =
      err && typeof err === "object" && err.message
        ? err.message
        : "Không thể cập nhật tài khoản. Vui lòng thử lại.";
    messageType.value = "error";
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}

onMounted(loadSettings);
</script>
```

```vue
              <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 text-slate-500 dark:border-[#3c342e] dark:text-[#b9aa9a]">
                <th class="px-2 py-3 font-medium text-left">Kênh bán</th>
                <th class="px-2 py-3 font-medium text-right">Doanh thu</th>
                <th class="px-2 py-3 font-medium text-right">Tỷ lệ</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              <tr v-for="method in paymentMethodBreakdown" :key="method.label" class="border-b border-slate-100 last:border-none dark:border-[#2b241f]">
                <td class="px-2 py-3">{{ method.label }}</td>
                <td class="px-2 py-3 text-right">
                  <div class="font-semibold">{{ formatCurrency(method.revenue) }}</div>
                  <div class="text-xs text-slate-500 dark:text-[#b9aa9a]">{{ method.count }} đơn</div>
                </td>
                <td class="px-2 py-3 text-right">{{ method.share }}%</td>
              </tr>
              <tr v-if="paymentMethodBreakdown.length === 0">
                <td class="px-2 py-3 text-center text-slate-500 dark:text-[#b9aa9a]" colspan="3">Chưa có dữ liệu</td>
              </tr>
            </tbody>
          </table>

          <div class="mt-4 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3c342e]">
            <table class="w-full text-sm">
              <tbody>
                <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3c342e]"><td class="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#b9aa9a]">Khoảng báo cáo</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">{{ selectedRangeText }}</td></tr>
                <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3c342e]"><td class="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#b9aa9a]">Doanh thu vào</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">{{ formatCurrency(filteredProfitRevenue) }}</td></tr>
                <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-[#3c342e]"><td class="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#b9aa9a]">Hoàn tiền</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold text-red-500 dark:text-red-400">{{ formatCurrency(Math.abs(filteredRefundRevenue)) }}</td></tr>
                <tr class="border-b border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 dark:border-[#3c342e] dark:bg-[#181310]"><td class="px-4 py-3 font-semibold">Lợi nhuận ròng kế toán</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-bold" :class="filteredNetRevenue >= 0 ? 'text-green-600 dark:text-green-400' : 'text-red-500 dark:text-red-400'">{{ formatCurrency(filteredNetRevenue) }}</td></tr>
                <tr><td class="px-4 py-3 text-slate-500 dark:text-[#b9aa9a]">Tỷ lệ hoàn tiền</td><td class="px-4 py-3 text-right font-semibold">{{ refundRate }}%</td></tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  </AdminShell>
</template>

<script setup>
import { computed, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";

import AdminShell from "@/components/admin/AdminShell.vue";
import { adminApi } from "@/services/api";
import {
  buildRevenueBuckets,
  filterOrdersByDateRange,
  filterOrdersByPayment,
  formatCurrency,
  formatLongDateTime,
  getPaymentBreakdown,
  getStatusBreakdown,
  normalizePaymentStatusValue,
  sortRevenueBuckets,
  sumNetRevenue,
  sumPositiveRevenue,
  sumRefundRevenue,
  getPaymentMethodBreakdown,
} from "@/utils/adminAnalytics";

const loading = ref(false);
const error = ref("");
const orders = ref([]);
const reportMode = ref("day");
const paymentFilter = ref("ALL");
const bucketSort = ref("newest");
const reportChartMetric = ref("net");
const reportPreset = ref("this_month");
const startDateInput = ref(defaultStartDateValue());
const endDateInput = ref(defaultEndDateValue());

const reportPresets = [
  { value: "7d", label: "7 ngày" },
  { value: "30d", label: "30 ngày" },
  { value: "qtd", label: "Quý này" },
  { value: "ytd", label: "Năm nay" },
  { value: "this_month", label: "Tháng này" },
];

function defaultEndDateValue() {
  return formatDateInput(new Date());
}

function defaultStartDateValue() {
  const today = new Date();
  return formatDateInput(new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth(), 1));
}

function formatDateInput(date) {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, "0");
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${year}-${month}-${day}`;
}

function parseDateInput(value, fallbackDate) {
  if (!value) return new Date(fallbackDate);
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return new Date(fallbackDate);
  return date;
}

function formatDateCell(value) {
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("vi-VN", {
    day: "2-digit",
    month: "2-digit",
    year: "numeric",
  }).format(value);
}

function createCsvContent(rows) {
  return `\uFEFF${rows
    .map((row) => row.map((cell) => `"${String(cell).replace(/"/g, '""')}"`).join(";"))
    .join("\r\n")}`;
}

function getOrderAmount(order) {
  const amount = Number(order?.finalAmount ?? order?.totalMoney ?? 0);
  return Number.isFinite(amount) ? Math.abs(amount) : 0;
}

function getOrderPaymentImpact(order) {
  const status = normalizePaymentStatusValue(order?.paymentStatus, order?.status);
  const amount = getOrderAmount(order);

  if (["DA_THANH_TOAN", "PAID", "SETTLED", "CAPTURED"].includes(status)) {
    return amount;
  }
  if (["HOAN_TIEN", "REFUNDED", "REFUND", "CHARGEBACK", "REVERSED"].includes(status)) {
    return -amount;
  }
  return 0;
}

function paymentStatusText(value) {
  const status = normalizePaymentStatusValue(value || null);
  if (["DA_THANH_TOAN", "PAID", "SETTLED", "CAPTURED"].includes(status)) return "Đã thanh toán";
  if (["HOAN_TIEN", "REFUNDED", "REFUND", "CHARGEBACK", "REVERSED"].includes(status)) return "Hoàn tiền";
  return "Chưa thanh toán";
}

const selectedStartDate = computed(() => parseDateInput(startDateInput.value, new Date()));
const selectedEndDate = computed(() => parseDateInput(endDateInput.value, new Date()));

watch([startDateInput, endDateInput], () => {
  if (selectedStartDate.value.getTime() > selectedEndDate.value.getTime()) {
    endDateInput.value = startDateInput.value;
  }
  reportPreset.value = "custom";
});

function applyReportPreset(preset) {
  const now = new Date();
  const end = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());
  let start = new Date(end);

  if (preset === "7d") {
    start.setDate(end.getDate() - 6);
    reportMode.value = "day";
  } else if (preset === "30d") {
    start.setDate(end.getDate() - 29);
    reportMode.value = "day";
  } else if (preset === "qtd") {
    const quarterStartMonth = Math.floor(end.getMonth() / 3) * 3;
    start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), quarterStartMonth, 1);
    reportMode.value = "month";
  } else if (preset === "ytd") {
    start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), 0, 1);
    reportMode.value = "month";
  } else {
    start = new Date(end.getFullYear(), end.getMonth(), 1);
    reportMode.value = "day";
  }

  reportPreset.value = preset;
  startDateInput.value = formatDateInput(start);
  endDateInput.value = formatDateInput(end);
}

const rangedOrders = computed(() => filterOrdersByDateRange(orders.value, selectedStartDate.value, selectedEndDate.value));
const filteredOrders = computed(() => filterOrdersByPayment(rangedOrders.value, paymentFilter.value));

const activeBuckets = computed(() => {
  return buildRevenueBuckets(filteredOrders.value, {
    mode: reportMode.value,
    startDate: selectedStartDate.value,
    endDate: selectedEndDate.value,
  });
});

const sortedActiveBuckets = computed(() => sortRevenueBuckets(activeBuckets.value, bucketSort.value));
const filteredNetRevenue = computed(() => sumNetRevenue(filteredOrders.value));
const filteredProfitRevenue = computed(() => sumPositiveRevenue(filteredOrders.value));
const filteredRefundRevenue = computed(() => sumRefundRevenue(filteredOrders.value));

const paymentBreakdown = computed(() => getPaymentBreakdown(filteredOrders.value));

const paymentBreakdownWithShare = computed(() => {
  const total = Math.max(filteredOrders.value.length, 1);
  return paymentBreakdown.value.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    share: Math.round((item.count / total) * 100),
  }));
});

const statusBreakdown = computed(() => getStatusBreakdown(filteredOrders.value));

const refundBreakdown = computed(() => {
  const refunds = filteredOrders.value.filter(o => {
    const st = normalizePaymentStatusValue(o?.paymentStatus, o?.status);
    return ["HOAN_TIEN", "REFUNDED", "REFUND", "CHARGEBACK", "REVERSED"].includes(st);
  });
  
  const groups = {};
  for (const r of refunds) {
    const method = r.paymentMethodName || r.paymentMethod || "Khác";
    const amount = Math.abs(Number(r.finalAmount ?? r.totalMoney ?? 0));
    groups[method] = (groups[method] || 0) + amount;
  }
  
  return Object.entries(groups).map(([method, amount]) => ({ method, amount })).sort((a,b) => b.amount - a.amount);
});

const reportMetricOptions = [
  { value: "net", label: "Ròng" },
  { value: "gross", label: "Doanh thu" },
  { value: "refund", label: "Hoàn" },
  { value: "orders", label: "Đơn" },
];

function getReportMetricValue(item) {
  if (!item) return 0;
  if (reportChartMetric.value === "gross") return Number(item.grossRevenue || 0);
  if (reportChartMetric.value === "refund") return Number(item.refundedRevenue || 0);
  if (reportChartMetric.value === "orders") return Number(item.orderCount || 0);
  return Number(item.netRevenue || 0);
}

const reportMetricColor = computed(() => {
  if (reportChartMetric.value === "gross") return "#2563eb";
  if (reportChartMetric.value === "refund") return "#ef4444";
  if (reportChartMetric.value === "orders") return "#7c3aed";
  return "#c66231";
});

const reportMetricLabel = computed(() => {
  const found = reportMetricOptions.find((item) => item.value === reportChartMetric.value);
  return found ? found.label : "Ròng";
});

const reportMetricTotal = computed(() => {
  return sortedActiveBuckets.value.reduce((sum, row) => sum + getReportMetricValue(row), 0);
});

const reportMetricTotalFormatted = computed(() => {
  if (reportChartMetric.value === "orders") return `${Math.round(reportMetricTotal.value)} đơn`;
  return formatCurrency(reportMetricTotal.value);
});

const reportBarSeries = computed(() => {
  const rows = sortedActiveBuckets.value;
  const values = rows.map((item) => Math.abs(getReportMetricValue(item)));
  const maxValue = Math.max(...values, 1);
  const count = Math.max(rows.length, 1);
  const step = count > 10 ? 42 : 78;
  const width = count > 10 ? 20 : 36;

  return rows.map((item, index) => {
    const metricValue = getReportMetricValue(item);
    const height = Math.max(8, (Math.abs(metricValue) / maxValue) * 148);
    return {
      key: `${item.key}-bar`,
      label: item.label,
      x: 44 + (index * step),
      y: 196 - height,
      width,
      height,
      fill: metricValue >= 0 ? reportMetricColor.value : "#ef4444",
    };
  });
});

const reportLinePoints = computed(() => {
  const rows = sortedActiveBuckets.value;
  const values = rows.map((item) => getReportMetricValue(item));
  const maxValue = Math.max(...values, 1);
  const minValue = Math.min(...values, 0);
  const range = Math.max(maxValue - minValue, 1);
  const count = Math.max(rows.length, 1);
  const step = count > 10 ? 42 : 78;
  const width = count > 10 ? 20 : 36;

  return rows.map((item, index) => ({
    key: `${item.key}-line`,
    x: 44 + (index * step) + (width / 2),
    y: 186 - (((getReportMetricValue(item) - minValue) / range) * 138),
  }));
});

const reportTrendPath = computed(() => {
  return reportLinePoints.value
    .map((point, index) => `${index === 0 ? "M" : "L"}${point.x},${point.y}`)
    .join(" ");
});

const reportHighlights = computed(() => sortedActiveBuckets.value.slice(0, Math.min(4, sortedActiveBuckets.value.length)));

const statusPieStyle = computed(() => {
  const total = Math.max(filteredOrders.value.length, 1);

  let start = 0;
  const segments = statusRowsWithShare.value.map((item) => {
    const end = start + ((item.count / total) * 100);
    const color = statusColor(item.status);
    const seg = `${color} ${start}% ${end}%`;
    start = end;
    return seg;
  });

  return {
    background: `conic-gradient(${segments.join(",")})`,
  };
});

function paymentColor(label) {
  if (label === "Đã thanh toán") return "#16a34a";
  if (label === "Hoàn tiền") return "#ef4444";
  if (label === "Chưa thanh toán") return "#2563eb";
  return "#64748b";
}

function statusColor(status) {
  if (status === "THANH_CONG") return "#16a34a";
  if (status === "DANG_GIAO") return "#2563eb";
  if (status === "DANG_XU_LY") return "#f59e0b";
  if (status === "DA_HUY") return "#ef4444";
  if (status === "RETURN_REQUEST" || status === "RETURNING") return "#f97316";
  if (status === "RETURNED") return "#8b5cf6";
  if (status === "DAMAGED" || status === "LOST") return "#be123c";
  if (status === "CHUA_XU_LY") return "#64748b";
  return "#64748b";
}

const statusRowsWithShare = computed(() => {
  const total = Math.max(filteredOrders.value.length, 1);
  return statusBreakdown.value.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    share: Math.round((item.count / total) * 100),
  }));
});

const paymentMethodBreakdown = computed(() => {
  return getPaymentMethodBreakdown(filteredOrders.value);
});

const selectedRangeText = computed(() => `${formatDateCell(selectedStartDate.value)} đến ${formatDateCell(selectedEndDate.value)}`);

const reportModeLabel = computed(() => {
  if (reportMode.value === "week") return "Theo tuần";
  if (reportMode.value === "month") return "Theo tháng";
  if (reportMode.value === "year") return "Theo năm";
  return "Theo ngày";
});

const reportModeText = computed(() => {
  if (reportMode.value === "week") return "theo tuần";
  if (reportMode.value === "month") return "theo tháng";
  if (reportMode.value === "year") return "theo năm";
  return "theo ngày";
});

const reportColumnLabel = computed(() => {
  if (reportMode.value === "week") return "Tuần";
  if (reportMode.value === "month") return "Tháng";
  if (reportMode.value === "year") return "Năm";
  return "Ngày";
});

const paymentFilterLabel = computed(() => {
  if (paymentFilter.value === "DA_THANH_TOAN") return "Đã thanh toán";
  if (paymentFilter.value === "HOAN_TIEN") return "Hoàn tiền";
  if (paymentFilter.value === "CHUA_THANH_TOAN") return "Chưa thanh toán";
  return "Tất cả thanh toán";
});

const paidOrdersCount = computed(() => paymentBreakdown.value.find((entry) => entry.label === "Đã thanh toán")?.count || 0);
const refundedOrdersCount = computed(() => paymentBreakdown.value.find((entry) => entry.label === "Hoàn tiền")?.count || 0);
const unpaidOrdersCount = computed(() => paymentBreakdown.value.find((entry) => entry.label === "Chưa thanh toán")?.count || 0);

const averageOrderValue = computed(() => {
  if (filteredOrders.value.length === 0) return 0;
  return Math.round(filteredNetRevenue.value / filteredOrders.value.length);
});

const refundRate = computed(() => {
  if (filteredProfitRevenue.value <= 0) return 0;
  return Math.round((filteredRefundRevenue.value / filteredProfitRevenue.value) * 1000) / 10;
});

async function loadReport() {
  loading.value = true;
  error.value = "";

  try {
    const ordersData = await adminApi.getOrders({ page: 0, size: 800 });
    orders.value = Array.isArray(ordersData) ? ordersData : [];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Failed to load reports:", err);
    error.value = "Không thể tải báo cáo tổng hợp. Vui lòng kiểm tra backend API.";
  } finally {
    loading.value = false;
  }
}

function buildCsvRows(mode = "detailed") {
  const rows = [
    ["BÁO CÁO DOANH THU KẾ TOÁN"],
    ["Generated At", new Date().toISOString()],
    ["Khoảng xem", selectedRangeText.value],
    ["Nhóm số liệu", reportModeLabel.value],
    ["Lọc thanh toán", paymentFilterLabel.value],
    ["Xuất lúc", formatLongDateTime(new Date())],
    [],
    ["TÓM TẮT"],
    ["Tổng đơn", filteredOrders.value.length],
    ["Đơn đã thanh toán", paidOrdersCount.value],
    ["Đơn chưa thanh toán", unpaidOrdersCount.value],
    ["Đơn hoàn tiền", refundedOrdersCount.value],
    ["Doanh thu vào", filteredProfitRevenue.value],
    ["Hoàn tiền", filteredRefundRevenue.value],
    ["Doanh thu ròng", filteredNetRevenue.value],
  ];

  if (mode === "summary") return rows;

  rows.push([]);
  rows.push(["CHI TIẾT THEO MỐC"]);
  rows.push([
    "period_label",
    "from_date",
    "to_date",
    "order_count",
    "paid_count",
    "refunded_count",
    "gross_revenue",
    "refunded_revenue",
    "net_revenue",
  ]);

  for (const item of sortedActiveBuckets.value) {
    rows.push([
      item.sublabel,
      formatDateCell(item.startDate),
      formatDateCell(item.endDate),
      item.orderCount,
      item.paidCount,
      item.refundedCount,
      item.grossRevenue,
      item.refundedRevenue,
      item.netRevenue,
    ]);
  }

  if (mode === "audit") {
    rows.push([]);
    rows.push(["ĐƠN HÀNG (TỐI ĐA 500 DÒNG)"]);
    rows.push(["order_id", "created_at_iso", "payment_status", "payment_impact"]);

    for (const order of filteredOrders.value.slice(0, 500)) {
      rows.push([
        order?.id ?? "",
        order?.createdAt ? new Date(order.createdAt).toISOString() : "",
        order?.paymentStatus || "",
        getOrderPaymentImpact(order),
      ]);
    }
  }

  return rows;
}

function downloadCsv(rows, suffix) {
  const csv = createCsvContent(rows);
  const blob = new Blob([csv], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.download = `bao-cao-ke-toan-${suffix}-${reportMode.value}-${startDateInput.value}-den-${endDateInput.value}.csv`;
  document.body.appendChild(link);
  link.click();
  document.body.removeChild(link);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
}

function exportSummaryCsv() {
  downloadCsv(buildCsvRows("summary"), "summary");
}

function exportCurrentCsv() {
  downloadCsv(buildCsvRows("detailed"), "detailed");
}

function exportAuditCsv() {
  downloadCsv(buildCsvRows("audit"), "audit");
}

function escaped(value) {
  return String(value ?? "")
    .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
    .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
    .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
    .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
    .replaceAll("'", "&#39;");
}

function printReport() {
  const revenueChartRows = sortedActiveBuckets.value.slice(0, 16);
  const revenueMax = Math.max(...revenueChartRows.map((row) => Math.abs(Number(row.netRevenue || 0))), 1);
  const revenueChartBars = revenueChartRows
    .map((row, index) => {
      const value = Number(row.netRevenue || 0);
      const x = 20 + index * 42;
      const h = Math.max(6, Math.round((Math.abs(value) / revenueMax) * 150));
      const y = 180 - h;
      const color = value >= 0 ? "#16a34a" : "#dc2626";
      return `
        <rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="24" height="${h}" fill="${color}" rx="4" />
        <text x="${x + 12}" y="196" text-anchor="middle" font-size="9" fill="#64748b">${escaped(String(row.sublabel || "").slice(0, 8))}</text>
      `;
    })
    .join("");

  const revenueRows = sortedActiveBuckets.value
    .map(
      (row) => `
        <tr>
          <td>${escaped(row.sublabel)}</td>
          <td>${escaped(formatDateCell(row.startDate))}</td>
          <td>${escaped(formatDateCell(row.endDate))}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(row.orderCount)}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(row.paidCount)}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(row.refundedCount)}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(formatCurrency(row.grossRevenue))}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(formatCurrency(row.refundedRevenue))}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(formatCurrency(row.netRevenue))}</td>
        </tr>`,
    )
    .join("");

  const paymentRows = paymentBreakdownWithShare.value
    .map(
      (item) => `
        <tr>
          <td>${escaped(item.label)}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(item.count)}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(item.share)}%</td>
        </tr>`,
    )
    .join("");

  const paymentChartRows = paymentBreakdownWithShare.value
    .map((item) => {
      const width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(item.share || 0)));
      const color =
        item.label === "Đã thanh toán"
          ? "#16a34a"
          : item.label === "Hoàn tiền"
            ? "#dc2626"
            : "#2563eb";
      return `
        <div class="pay-row">
          <div class="pay-head"><span>${escaped(item.label)}</span><span>${escaped(item.count)} đơn (${escaped(item.share)}%)</span></div>
          <div class="pay-track"><div class="pay-fill" style="width:${width}%;background:${color};"></div></div>
        </div>
      `;
    })
    .join("");

  const statusRows = statusRowsWithShare.value
    .map(
      (item) => `
        <tr>
          <td>${escaped(item.label)}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(item.count)}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(item.share)}%</td>
        </tr>`,
    )
    .join("");

  const statusChartRows = statusRowsWithShare.value
    .map((item) => {
      const width = Math.max(0, Math.min(100, Number(item.share || 0)));
      return `
        <div class="pay-row">
          <div class="pay-head"><span>${escaped(item.label)}</span><span>${escaped(item.count)} đơn (${escaped(item.share)}%)</span></div>
          <div class="pay-track"><div class="pay-fill" style="width:${width}%;background:${statusColor(item.status)};"></div></div>
        </div>
      `;
    })
    .join("");

  const orderRows = filteredOrders.value
    .slice(0, 500)
    .map((order, index) => {
      const orderStatus = order?.status || order?.orderStatus || order?.deliveryStatus || "-";
      const amount = getOrderAmount(order);
      const impact = getOrderPaymentImpact(order);
      return `
        <tr>
          <td class="right">${escaped(index + 1)}</td>
          <td>${escaped(order?.id ?? "-")}</td>
          <td>${escaped(formatLongDateTime(order?.createdAt || ""))}</td>
          <td>${escaped(paymentStatusText(order?.paymentStatus))}</td>
          <td>${escaped(String(orderStatus))}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(formatCurrency(amount))}</td>
          <td class="right">${escaped(formatCurrency(impact))}</td>
        </tr>
      `;
    })
    .join("");

  const html = `<!doctype html>
<html lang="vi">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />

  const iframe = document.createElement("iframe");
  iframe.style.position = "fixed";
  iframe.style.width = "0";
  iframe.style.height = "0";
  iframe.style.border = "0";
  iframe.style.right = "0";
  iframe.style.bottom = "0";
  document.body.appendChild(iframe);

  const cleanup = () => {
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (document.body.contains(iframe)) {
        document.body.removeChild(iframe);
      }
    }, 500);
  };

  iframe.onload = () => {
    const w = iframe.contentWindow;
    if (!w) {
      cleanup();
      return;
    }
    w.focus();
    w.print();
    cleanup();
  };

  iframe.srcdoc = html;
}

onMounted(loadReport);
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, watch } from "vue";
import AdminShell from "@/components/admin/AdminShell.vue";
import { brandsApi, adminApi, resolveImageUrl } from "@/services/api";

// State
const brands = ref([]);
const hiddenBrands = ref([]);
const loading = ref(false);
const error = ref("");
const searchQuery = ref("");
const currentPage = ref(1);
const pageSize = ref(10);


// Modal state
const showModal = ref(false);
const editingBrandId = ref(null);
const saving = ref(false);
const modalError = ref("");
const previewError = ref(false);
const brandImageFile = ref(null);

const visibleBrands = computed(() => {
  return brands.value.filter(
    (brand) =>
      !hiddenBrands.value.some(
        (hidden) => Number(brand.id) === Number(hidden.id),
      ),
  );
});

// Delete state
const deleteTarget = ref(null);
const deleting = ref(false);

// Form data
const form = ref({
  name: "",
  slug: "",
  logoUrl: "",
});

const errors = ref({});

// Computed
const filteredBrands = computed(() => {
  const keyword = searchQuery.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!keyword) {
    return visibleBrands.value;
  }

  return visibleBrands.value.filter((brand) => {
    const haystack = [brand.name, brand.slug, brand.slugDisplay, brand.id]
      .filter((item) => item !== undefined && item !== null)
      .join(" ")
      .toLowerCase();

    return haystack.includes(keyword);
  });
});

const totalPages = computed(() =>
  Math.ceil(filteredBrands.value.length / pageSize.value),
);

const paginatedBrands = computed(() => {
  const start = (currentPage.value - 1) * pageSize.value;
  const end = start + pageSize.value;
  return filteredBrands.value.slice(start, end);
});

// Methods
function handleImageUpload(event) {
  const file = event.target?.files?.[0];
  if (!file) return;

  if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
    modalError.value = "Vui lòng chọn tệp ảnh hợp lệ.";
    return;
  }

  if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
    modalError.value = "Kích thước ảnh không được vượt quá 5MB.";
    return;
  }

  modalError.value = "";
  brandImageFile.value = file;
  
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (e) => {
    form.value.logoUrl = e.target?.result || "";
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  event.target.value = "";
}

function resetForm() {
  form.value = {
    name: "",
    slug: "",
    logoUrl: "",
  };
  errors.value = {};
  previewError.value = false;
  editingBrandId.value = null;
  modalError.value = "";
}

function openCreateModal() {
  resetForm();
  showModal.value = true;
}

function openEditModal(brand) {
  resetForm();
  editingBrandId.value = brand.id;
  form.value = {
    name: brand.name || "",
    slug: brand.slugDisplay || "",
    logoUrl: brand.logoUrl || "",
  };
  showModal.value = true;
}

function closeModal() {
  showModal.value = false;
  resetForm();
}

function validateForm() {
  errors.value = {};

  if (!form.value.name || form.value.name.trim() === "") {
    errors.value.name = "Vui lòng nhập tên thương hiệu";
    return false;
  }

  if (form.value.name.length > 100) {
    errors.value.name = "Tên thương hiệu không được vượt quá 100 ký tự";
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

function generateSlug(name) {
  if (!name) return "";
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}

function pickBrandSlug(source) {
  const item = source && typeof source === "object" ? source : {};
  return (
    item.slug ??
    item.slugName ??
    item.slug_name ??
    item.seoSlug ??
    item.seo_slug ??
    ""
  );
}

function normalizeBrandRecord(source) {
  const item = source && typeof source === "object" ? source : {};
  const name = String(item.name || "").trim();
  const slugValue = String(pickBrandSlug(item) || "").trim();

  return {
    ...item,
    name,
    slugDisplay: slugValue || (name ? generateSlug(name) : ""),
    logoUrl:
      item.logoUrl || item.logo_url
        ? resolveImageUrl(item.logoUrl || item.logo_url)
        : null,
  };
}

// Watch name to auto-generate slug
watch(
  () => form.value.name,
  (newName, oldName) => {
    if (!form.value.slug || form.value.slug === generateSlug(oldName || "")) {
      form.value.slug = generateSlug(newName);
    }
  },
);

async function submitForm() {
  if (!validateForm()) return;

  saving.value = true;
  modalError.value = "";

  try {
    let finalImageUrl = form.value.logoUrl;
    if (brandImageFile.value) {
      try {
        const uploadRes = await adminApi.uploadImage(brandImageFile.value);
        if (uploadRes && uploadRes.imageUrl) {
          finalImageUrl = uploadRes.imageUrl;
        }
      } catch (uploadErr) {
        modalError.value = "Lỗi khi upload ảnh. Vui lòng thử lại.";
        saving.value = false;
        return;
      }
    }
    const payload = {
      name: form.value.name.trim(),
      slug: form.value.slug?.trim() || generateSlug(form.value.name),
      logoUrl: finalImageUrl || null,
    };

    if (editingBrandId.value) {
      await brandsApi.update(editingBrandId.value, payload);
    } else {
      await brandsApi.create(payload);
    }

    closeModal();
    await fetchBrands();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Lỗi khi lưu thương hiệu:", err);
    modalError.value =
      err?.message ||
      (editingBrandId.value
        ? "Không thể cập nhật thương hiệu"
        : "Không thể thêm thương hiệu");
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}

function confirmDelete(brand) {
  deleteTarget.value = brand;
}

async function deleteBrand() {
    if (!deleteTarget.value) return;
    deleting.value = true;
    try {
      await brandsApi.delete(deleteTarget.value.id);
      brands.value = brands.value.filter((item) => Number(item.id) !== Number(deleteTarget.value.id));
      deleteTarget.value = null;
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Lỗi khi xóa: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      deleting.value = false;
    }
  }

async function fetchBrands() {
  loading.value = true;
  error.value = "";

  try {
    const response = await brandsApi.getAll();
    let brandList = [];

    if (Array.isArray(response)) {
      brandList = response;
    } else if (
      response &&
      response.content &&
      Array.isArray(response.content)
    ) {
      brandList = response.content;
    } else if (response && response.data && Array.isArray(response.data)) {
      brandList = response.data;
    }

    brands.value = brandList.map(normalizeBrandRecord);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Lỗi khi tải danh sách thương hiệu:", err);
    error.value =
      "Không thể tải danh sách thương hiệu. Vui lòng kiểm tra backend API.";
  } finally {
    loading.value = false;
  }
}

function handleImageError(e) {
  previewError.value = true;
  e.target.style.display = "none";
}

async function restoreBrand(brand) {
  try {
    await brandsApi.restoreBrand(brand.id);
    const restoredId = Number(brand?.id);
    hiddenBrands.value = hiddenBrands.value.filter(
      (hidden) => Number(hidden.id) !== restoredId,
    );
    await fetchBrands();
  } catch (err) {
    error.value = "Không thể khôi phục thương hiệu.";
  }
}

async function restoreAllHiddenBrands() {
  try {
    for (const brand of hiddenBrands.value) {
      await brandsApi.restoreBrand(brand.id);
    }
    hiddenBrands.value = [];
    await fetchBrands();
  } catch (err) {
    error.value = "Có lỗi xảy ra khi khôi phục.";
  }
}

// Watch search to reset page
watch(searchQuery, () => {
  currentPage.value = 1;
});

// Lifecycle
onMounted(() => {
  fetchBrands();
});
</script>
```

```vue
<script setup>
import { ref, computed, onMounted, watch } from "vue";
import AdminShell from "@/components/admin/AdminShell.vue";
import { categoriesApi, adminApi, resolveImageUrl } from "@/services/api";

// State
const categorys = ref([]);
const hiddenCategories = ref([]);
const loading = ref(false);
const error = ref("");
const searchQuery = ref("");
const currentPage = ref(1);
const pageSize = ref(10);


// Modal state
const showModal = ref(false);
const editingCategoryId = ref(null);
const saving = ref(false);
const modalError = ref("");
const previewError = ref(false);
const categoryImageFile = ref(null);

const visibleCategories = computed(() => {
  return categorys.value.filter(
    (category) =>
      !hiddenCategories.value.some(
        (hidden) => Number(category.id) === Number(hidden.id),
      ),
  );
});

// Delete state
const deleteTarget = ref(null);
const deleting = ref(false);

// Form data
const form = ref({
  name: "",
  slug: "",
  imageUrl: "",
});

const errors = ref({});

// Computed
const filteredCategorys = computed(() => {
  const keyword = searchQuery.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!keyword) {
    return visibleCategories.value;
  }

  return visibleCategories.value.filter((category) => {
    const haystack = [category.name, category.slug, category.slugDisplay, category.id]
      .filter((item) => item !== undefined && item !== null)
      .join(" ")
      .toLowerCase();

    return haystack.includes(keyword);
  });
});

const totalPages = computed(() =>
  Math.ceil(filteredCategorys.value.length / pageSize.value),
);

const paginatedCategories = computed(() => {
  const start = (currentPage.value - 1) * pageSize.value;
  const end = start + pageSize.value;
  return filteredCategorys.value.slice(start, end);
});

// Methods
function handleImageUpload(event) {
  const file = event.target?.files?.[0];
  if (!file) return;

  if (!file.type.startsWith("image/")) {
    modalError.value = "Vui lòng chọn tệp ảnh hợp lệ.";
    return;
  }

  if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
    modalError.value = "Kích thước ảnh không được vượt quá 5MB.";
    return;
  }

  modalError.value = "";
  categoryImageFile.value = file;
  
  const reader = new FileReader();
  reader.onload = (e) => {
    form.value.imageUrl = e.target?.result || "";
  };
  reader.readAsDataURL(file);
  event.target.value = "";
}

function resetForm() {
  form.value = {
    name: "",
    slug: "",
    imageUrl: "",
  };
  errors.value = {};
  previewError.value = false;
  editingCategoryId.value = null;
  modalError.value = "";
}

function openCreateModal() {
  resetForm();
  showModal.value = true;
}

function openEditModal(category) {
  resetForm();
  editingCategoryId.value = category.id;
  form.value = {
    name: category.name || "",
    slug: category.slugDisplay || "",
    imageUrl: category.imageUrl || "",
  };
  showModal.value = true;
}

function closeModal() {
  showModal.value = false;
  resetForm();
}

function validateForm() {
  errors.value = {};

  if (!form.value.name || form.value.name.trim() === "") {
    errors.value.name = "Vui lòng nhập tên danh mục";
    return false;
  }

  if (form.value.name.length > 100) {
    errors.value.name = "Tên danh mục không được vượt quá 100 ký tự";
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

function generateSlug(name) {
  if (!name) return "";
  return name
    .toLowerCase()
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, "")
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
}

function pickCategorySlug(source) {
  const item = source && typeof source === "object" ? source : {};
  return (
    item.slug ??
    item.slugName ??
    item.slug_name ??
    item.seoSlug ??
    item.seo_slug ??
    ""
  );
}

function normalizeCategoryRecord(source) {
  const item = source && typeof source === "object" ? source : {};
  const name = String(item.name || "").trim();
  const slugValue = String(pickCategorySlug(item) || "").trim();

  return {
    ...item,
    name,
    slugDisplay: slugValue || (name ? generateSlug(name) : ""),
    imageUrl:
      item.imageUrl || item.logo_url
        ? resolveImageUrl(item.imageUrl || item.logo_url)
        : null,
  };
}

// Watch name to auto-generate slug
watch(
  () => form.value.name,
  (newName, oldName) => {
    if (!form.value.slug || form.value.slug === generateSlug(oldName || "")) {
      form.value.slug = generateSlug(newName);
    }
  },
);

async function submitForm() {
  if (!validateForm()) return;

  saving.value = true;
  modalError.value = "";

  try {
    let finalImageUrl = form.value.imageUrl;
    if (categoryImageFile.value) {
      try {
        const uploadRes = await adminApi.uploadImage(categoryImageFile.value);
        if (uploadRes && uploadRes.imageUrl) {
          finalImageUrl = uploadRes.imageUrl;
        }
      } catch (uploadErr) {
        modalError.value = "Lỗi khi upload ảnh. Vui lòng thử lại.";
        saving.value = false;
        return;
      }
    }
    const payload = {
      name: form.value.name.trim(),
      slug: form.value.slug?.trim() || generateSlug(form.value.name),
      imageUrl: finalImageUrl || null,
    };

    if (editingCategoryId.value) {
      await categoriesApi.update(editingCategoryId.value, payload);
    } else {
      await categoriesApi.create(payload);
    }

    closeModal();
    await fetchCategories();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Lỗi khi lưu danh mục:", err);
    modalError.value =
      err?.message ||
      (editingCategoryId.value
        ? "Không thể cập nhật danh mục"
        : "Không thể thêm danh mục");
  } finally {
    saving.value = false;
  }
}

function confirmDelete(category) {
  deleteTarget.value = category;
}

async function deleteCategory() {
    if (!deleteTarget.value) return;
    deleting.value = true;
    try {
      await categoriesApi.delete(deleteTarget.value.id);
      categorys.value = categorys.value.filter((item) => Number(item.id) !== Number(deleteTarget.value.id));
      deleteTarget.value = null;
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Lỗi khi xóa: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      deleting.value = false;
    }
  }

async function fetchCategories() {
  loading.value = true;
  error.value = "";

  try {
    const response = await categoriesApi.getAll();
    let categoryList = [];

    if (Array.isArray(response)) {
      categoryList = response;
    } else if (
      response &&
      response.content &&
      Array.isArray(response.content)
    ) {
      categoryList = response.content;
    } else if (response && response.data && Array.isArray(response.data)) {
      categoryList = response.data;
    }

    categorys.value = categoryList.map(normalizeCategoryRecord);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Lỗi khi tải danh sách danh mục:", err);
    error.value =
      "Không thể tải danh sách danh mục. Vui lòng kiểm tra backend API.";
  } finally {
    loading.value = false;
  }
}

function handleImageError(e) {
  previewError.value = true;
  e.target.style.display = "none";
}

async function restoreCategory(category) {
  try {
    await categoriesApi.restoreCategory(category.id);
    const restoredId = Number(category?.id);
    hiddenCategories.value = hiddenCategories.value.filter(
      (hidden) => Number(hidden.id) !== restoredId,
    );
    await fetchCategories();
  } catch (err) {
    error.value = "Không thể khôi phục danh mục.";
  }
}

async function restoreAllHiddenCategorys() {
  try {
    for (const category of hiddenCategories.value) {
      await categoriesApi.restoreCategory(category.id);
    }
    hiddenCategories.value = [];
    await fetchCategories();
  } catch (err) {
    error.value = "Có lỗi xảy ra khi khôi phục.";
  }
}

// Watch search to reset page
watch(searchQuery, () => {
  currentPage.value = 1;
});

// Lifecycle
onMounted(() => {
  fetchCategories();
});
</script>

<style scoped>
.retail-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.dark .retail-card {
  background: #1a1a1a;
  border-color: #2d2d2d;
}

.material-symbols-outlined {
  font-size: 20px;
}
</style>
```

```vue
                <label class="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-500">Gi� b�n chung (VND) *</label>

              </div>
              <div>
                <label class="mb-1 block text-sm font-medium text-slate-500">S? lu?ng bi?n th? chung *</label>
                <input v-model.number="bulkForm.stockQuantity" type="number" min="0" class="w-full  shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:border-primary/30 transition-all duration-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm " />

              S? t?o ra: <strong>{{ newCombinationsCount }}</strong> bi?n th?.

            <button type="button" :disabled="bulkGenerating || !bulkForm.productId || newCombinationsCount === 0" class="rounded-xl bg-orange-500 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white hover:bg-orange-600 disabled:opacity-50" @click="doBulkCreate">
              {{ bulkGenerating ? "�ang x? l�..." : "B?t d?u t?o" }}
            </button>
```
